title: Tokenized Domains Need a DNS Maintenance and Handoff Checklist

cover.subtitle: Maintain records, permissions and service continuity.
cover.visual: A tiny domain token icon sits beside a separate DNS zone checklist. No claim that token ownership alone configures DNS.

sections.name: 01-an-operating-inventory-identifies-every-control-point
sections.heading: An operating inventory identifies every control point
sections.scene: Two parallel inventories: a wallet and registrar/DNS accounts above, website/mail/TXT services below. Connect each service to its responsible account without implying NFT transfers DNS packets.
sections.alt: An operating inventory identifies every control point.

sections.name: 02-routine-changes-preserve-the-active-zone-and-service-owners
sections.heading: Routine changes preserve the active zone and service owners
sections.scene: A generic zone document shows only labels A, MX, TXT and blank line placeholders for all values. Highlight only the A row. A small rollback arrow points only at the highlighted A row. MX and TXT rows remain unchanged. No IP addresses, domains, actual policy strings or record values.
sections.alt: Routine changes preserve the active zone and service owners.

sections.name: 03-ownership-changes-require-a-separate-access-review
sections.heading: Ownership changes require a separate access review
sections.scene: A token moves between owner wallets while separate DNS user, API key, and recovery-contact cards pass through an access review gate.
sections.alt: Ownership changes require a separate access review.

sections.name: 04-monitoring-and-recovery-verify-the-complete-service
sections.heading: Monitoring and recovery verify the complete service
sections.scene: A monitor checks DNS, HTTPS, and mail separately. A saved zone inventory connects to a recovery checklist with a verified-result checkmark.
sections.alt: Monitoring and recovery verify the complete service.

purpose: Initial illustration plan. The final image review manifest records actual asset hashes and visual revisions.
